title: Rossi devices and ring superconductor experiments

tellings.quote: I built a handful of different uh devices that um uh had some interesting effects that seemed to substantiate what a lot of the theory that people like uh Dr. Puthoff, um uh Dr. Davis, and others um have discussed.

plain: Between 2021 and 2024, a man named Dave Rossi says he built a handful of devices, including experiments with ring-shaped superconductors, that produced "interesting effects" which seemed to back up theories discussed by Dr. Hal Puthoff, Dr. Eric W. Davis and others. Rossi tells Michels this firsthand, on an episode where he says aliens taught him advanced physics. If true, it would mean those theories about exotic propulsion can be tested at a workbench.
